answer: We formalize a juniper-anchored bond mechanism wherein identity admission requires posting dynamic opportunity-cost capital that scales with adversarial mass, and a beacon-triggered subgame-perfect slashing matrix enforces reversion to honest participation. Capital barrier analysis proves Sybil multiplication yields strictly negative expected payoff, as marginal bond costs dominate discounted deviations, while punishment convergence guarantees strict Nash equilibrium in multi-agent adversarial settings.
